fields.Name: Skip ICF - Multi-Dimensional Engagement Scoring
fields.Description: Weighted engagement score with per-factor breakdown and drill to underlying activities. Ported from "Multi-Dimensional Engagement Scoring" (chapter leadership replaced by committee service, plus advocacy).

InputDefinition.userMessage: Create an engagement score for all members using these weighted factors: conference attendance (30%), course completion (25%), committee service (20%), advocacy actions (15%), and years as a member (10%). Normalize each factor so the score is 0-100. Show the top 20 members in a ranked table. When I click a member, show a chart of how each factor contributed to their score. Then let me click a factor to see the underlying activities. [NO CHAT]

judgeValidationCriteria: Response includes a ranked table of the top 20 members with a 0-100 score
The five factors use the stated weights and come from real data (Event Order Lines, Course Enrollments, Committees: Memberships, Advocacy Actions, Member Profiles JoinDate)
Clicking a member shows a factor breakdown chart
Clicking a factor shows the underlying activity records
Rows can open the underlying records
